industry.railways: Indian Railways carries the passengers; IRCTC sells ~89% of reserved tickets online (13.27 crore tickets in Q1FY27, 14.58 lakh a day; share 88.92% vs 88.78%). Of daily bookings ~53-54% come through the RailConnect app, ~17% the website and ~28% business associates (OTAs such as MakeMyTrip, ixigo); G2G bookings for defence forces are the rest (Q1FY27 call).
industry.passengers: Management cites ~8% year-on-year passenger growth (Q1FY27 call). New premium capacity: Vande Bharat chair-car trains (81 catered by IRCTC) and ~20 Vande Bharat sleeper trains expected over the next year.
industry.railOne: RailOne, the Railways' own super-app (built by CRIS), sells reserved, unreserved and platform tickets but books reserved tickets through IRCTC's system; management saw 'some diversion' of non-convenience income (Q1FY27 call).
industry.catering: Catering prices are administered by the Ministry of Railways (last revised in 2019, PL Q4 call question); opt-out of meals on prepaid trains is ~25-30%; e-catering ~1.7 lakh meals a day; branded players and centralised kitchens under discussion.
industry.travel: Choice (23-Sep-2026) groups IRCTC with travel platforms (ixigo, TBO Tek, RateGain): online travel penetration rising to 46% by FY27E; domestic travel 86% of tourism spend; Bharat Gaurav trains ~40% of IRCTC tourism revenue.
industry.src: Q1FY27 call (13-Aug-2026); Q4FY26 call (27-May-2026); Business Today on Choice initiation (22/23-Sep-2026)

peers.approach: No clean listed peer. Brokers group IRCTC with travel and consumer-internet platforms (PL covers it with hotels and aviation; Choice with ixigo, TBO Tek and RateGain), the market also trades it in the railway-PSU basket (Nifty India Railways PSU index; DIPAM's OFS pipeline).

peers.note: Usable internet/travel-platform peers with a P/E history: NAUKRI and INDIAMART only (as in the ETERNAL report). The market trades IRCTC with railway PSUs; the service businesses among them with a five-year P/E history are CONCOR, RAILTEL and RITES. These five are the only names with a usable five-year history, so the base sector move uses all five (PLAYBOOK §7c: full peer set); internet-only, railway-PSU-only and no-move are sensitivity rows (GAM review, Nov-2026).

governance.relatedParty: Indian Railways is owner, regulator, main customer (receivables Rs1,882 cr) and revenue-share partner (licence fees, Rail Neer profit share 15:85 / 40:60); balances 'subject to reconciliation with the Railways' (AR note 49)
